name: 4180-stripped-tests

violates.text: With a fixture reflection directory in which two of the seven UTC days preceding the report's own day have no knowledge-health-YYYY-MM-DD.md and the rest do, the '## Reflection Retention' section prints one line naming exactly those two dates (e.g. 'Knowledge-health reports expected and absent in the previous 7 UTC days: 2026-11-13, 2026-11-14') — tests/test_knowledge_health_retention.py

With every one of the seven UTC days present, the section prints one line saying none is absent and names no date; a day equal to the report's own UTC day is never named, even when its file is not on disk at render time — tests/test_knowledge_health_retention.py

note: Label by construction, not by any reader or grader: tests/test_knowledge_health_retention.py is restored to its parent, taking the 292 added lines. Clauses 1 and 2 describe a new line the Reflection Retention section prints for absent report days, against a fixture directory; nothing left in the tree builds that fixture or reads that line. Never re-mark this case to match a grader's answer.
